Forty-six male polysubstance use disorder patients in the early abstinence period and 30 healthy male controls underwent structural magnetic resonance imaging scans.
Imaging was performed using a 1.5 T MR scanner (Achieva, Philips Healthcare, Best, the Netherlands) with a SENSE-Head-8 coil at NPISTANBUL Neuropsychiatry Istanbul Hospital.

A T1-weighted MPRAGE sequence was employed to achieve a high-resolution anatomical scan (repetition time =8.6, echo time =4, flip angle =8, voxel size 0.9375/0.9375/1.2 mm; slice spacing =1.2 mm, field of view =240 mm, and 125 slices).
